parsed.why: Strong state protections operate: gender-identity anti-discrimination, hate-crime enhancement, facilities access, and a court ruling ordering care resumed. Parent passport and entry regime still applies, plus pending ballot measures and national funding pressure.

Executive order backs birth-sex facilities, no state-wide gender-identity discrimination law, documented custody placement by birth sex with harm, and a minor-care ban. Falls below the parent line with no offsetting protections.

Documented, operating protections: public-accommodations nondiscrimination, gender-identity hate-crime law, self-determined markers and X on licences, shield laws, and no facility exclusion. Parent regime still applies at entry.

Public-building bathroom ban enforced by public complaint form with a documentary defence visitors cannot meet, plus pride-flag ban and minor-care ban. Partial nondiscrimination and hate-crime coverage offset little.

Sex-designated facility bans with a private cause of action, school bans, sports ban, minor-care ban, surgery-based marker rules, and no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime law. Listed among the worst, so placed lowest here.
